Every material shares this environment: character skin/hair/uniform/eyes, held paper/book/pen, linen/wood, the chair/bench supports, shoes and adjacent floor. Preserve refined youthful 2D anime linework and soft modeled shading naturally integrated with the detailed literary-room illustration. Entire frame, true source scale and support, no second person/extra limb, no UI, labels, icons, logo, watermark, collage, border, fog or new props.
